verdict.rationale: The docs give some trust-relevant transparency—skills are shipped as plain, ownable files that 'nothing updates behind your back' and can be pulled explicitly via `npx skills update`, plus acceptance into Claude Code's official marketplace as a vetted distribution channel—but there is no explicit security-posture document covering what skills can execute (tool/permission scope), a formal trust model for arbitrary third-party skills, or any statement on telemetry/data collection. missing for 10: explicit execution/permission model for skills, documented telemetry or data-collection policy, formal third-party skill vetting/trust framework beyond marketplace acceptance.
